# Vendored frontend dependencies

## Chart.js

- Version: 4.5.1
- Source package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/chart.js
- Bundled file: `chart.umd.min.js`
- Original package path: `dist/chart.umd.min.js`
- License: MIT

Chart.js is bundled locally so the speed_test dashboard does not require
Internet access to render charts.
